name: robinhood-trading
description: Human-gated equity trading loop for Robinhood's official agentic-trading MCP server (https://agent.robinhood.com/mcp/trading), bundled via .mcp.json with OAuth handled by Claude Code — no API keys, no stored credentials. Portfolio snapshot analysis (concentration/HHI, cash drag, loss-runners), a deterministic pre-trade risk gate modeled on SEC Rule 15c3-5 (budget, concentration, order-type, rate-limit and account checks — verdict is CLEARED-FOR-HUMAN-CONFIRMATION, never auto-approval), review-before-place order discipline, and an auditable local trade journal that refuses to record a placed order without a named human approval. Never places an order without explicit per-order human confirmation, never runs unattended trading loops, never gives investment advice. 3 stdlib Python tools.
